name: Hayakkom AI-prepared enquiry
audience: AI assistants acting for a human user who has agreed to share the details

how_to_send.note: A human coordinator reads it and replies. Nothing is booked, quoted or charged automatically. Do not send diagnoses, detailed symptoms, medicines, scans, passport/ID or payment details.

fields.on_behalf_of_user_consent: boolean - the human user agreed to share these details
fields.name: string (optional)
fields.purpose: holiday | treatment | dental | doctor_now_in_egypt | partnership | property_trip | corporate_event | careers | other
fields.interest: free text, user's own words (e.g. 'dental implants', 'Sharm family holiday')
fields.preferences: hotel level, villa/apartment, prayer/halal/women-only, mobility, privacy

rules: Only send with the human user's consent.
Prices on hayakkom.com are indicative ranges in SAR excluding flights, not quotes.
Hayakkom is a coordination company, not a hospital or tour operator, and is not certified by Google.
